name: Mueller's Splatting Approach
definition: A gray scale volume treated as a 3D discrete density function where a convolution kernel defines reconstruction of a continuous function from density samples, considering how a sample contributes to many points in space.
summary: Mueller's Splatting Approach is an object-order volume rendering method that accelerates DVR by projecting voxel footprints onto pixels, exploiting cache coherency for sequential memory traversal.
